description.value: The Maq Hotel is a recently reimagined boutique hotel sitting in the heart of Tofino with harbour views, locally commissioned art in every room, and a lively on-site scene that includes a café, bierhaus, and pub. With decades of history behind it and a self-described 'one-stop hub' ethos, it draws both travellers and locals alike. Touring cyclists finishing a west coast ride will find a centrally located, dog-welcoming base steps from Tofino's surf beaches and amenities.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms the hotel's address, phone, and email match OSM exactly. The site describes rooms, on-site food and drink venues (café, bierhaus, pub), and a pet-friendly policy, but contains no mention of bike storage, bike procedures, laundry, or any cycling-specific amenities — those fields must remain null. On-site evening food is clearly confirmed via The BEAR Bierhaus and MAQ Pub.
concerns: No mention of bike storage or cycling amenities anywhere on the website; required criteria cannot be verified.
The MAQ Café is noted as seasonally closed (November 2025 – February 2026), indicating partial on-site food service during shoulder/off season.

enrichment_extras.notes: The on-site liquor store ('Open every day, 11am–11pm') and multiple food/drink venues make this a strong candidate if bike storage can be confirmed via direct contact.
